findings.claim: On a casual install the routine worktree receives the skill-re-enabling overlay (.claude/settings.local.json) only after routine_worktree_create returns, but routine_worktree_create already ran its pipeline claude session inside that worktree: a chain-based run whose merge of main conflicts launches the unattended `/merge-resolve theirs main` claude -p (routines/_lib/worktree.sh:64-80, called from :171) while merge-resolve is still skillOverrides "off" at user scope (sync_skills.sh:265-267 turns every repo leaf off, skills/git/merge-resolve is a leaf). The skill is hidden and denied there (sync_skills.sh:246 comment: off hides AND denies, incl. headless), so the sync never resolves, the merge-tree gate fails, create returns 1 and run.sh exits 70 before publish. Because the failed attempt never commits, the chain tip is unchanged and every following night repeats the same failure until someone deletes the branch by hand — the casual user has no UI for that.
findings.evidence: Re-read routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:128-148 at the head: `wt="$(routine_worktree_create)"` (128) precedes the overlay copy `cp "$skill_overlay" "$wt/.claude/settings.local.json"` (144-148). Re-read routines/_lib/worktree.sh:162-176: `worktree add` then, for base != main, `routine_chain_sync_main "$wt"`, which on a conflicted merge runs `claude -p "/merge-resolve theirs main..."` in `$wt` (56-91); the fresh worktree has no .claude/settings.local.json because .gitignore:51 ignores it, so only user scope (~/.claude/settings.json, skillOverrides merge-resolve=off written by sync_skills.sh:263-269 on casual) applies. After the failed resolve the worktree is clean (merge aborted) but `git merge-tree --write-tree main HEAD` fails (86-89), so create removes the new branch and returns 1 (171-176); run.sh:132-136 exits 70 with no publish, leaving the unmerged chain tip as the next night's base (worktree.sh:134-144; routine_branch_only_failures is false for a non-[failed] rejected/kept run). Preconditions: casual profile (overlay exists), an unmerged dated branch (orchestrate rejection keeps the branch, smine-orchestrate SKILL.md:29) and a main that moved with a conflicting change (e.g. an in-place update touching a skill the run auto-applied). spec-5 C4 (correctness-51) requires the overlay to re-enable the pipeline's skills in each routine worktree; the merge-resolve run is a pipeline run in that worktree without it.
findings.fix: Copy ~/.config/claude-routine/skill-overrides.json into "$wt/.claude/settings.local.json" inside routine_worktree_create right after `git worktree add` (before routine_chain_sync_main), and drop the later copy in run.sh.
